title: Writing: With a Clock
label: ch:ja-writing-with-a-clock
canDo: I can fill in a five-field form inside a three-minute clock, I know the 30-40 sign message this book's A1 paper adds, and I know that the JLPT has no writing paper to rehearse.

payoff.summary: Complete JA-W144-with-a-clock: five form fields against a three-minute timer, then at most one minute checking the small signs.
payoff.note: JLPT tests vocabulary, grammar, reading and listening and scores no writing at any level. The task follows the JF Standard A1 Can-dos (a small form and a short personal message); the 30-40 sign length is japanese/assessment-spec.md#a1, and the three-minute clock is the book's own, which keeps the lesson inside the five-minute cap. The N5 pass rule the lesson ends on is JLPT's: 80/180 overall plus 38/120 and 19/60 sectional minimums.
